about: Barefoot Surf School is based in Braunton, North Devon, and teaches and hires at Putsborough Sands, a sheltered beach near Croyde and Woolacombe. Alongside surf lessons, it offers SUP and sandboarding. Its hire range covers a wide choice of boards and wetsuits, with hire open to people who have already had a beginner lesson.
offers: Surfboard hire: softboards, shortboards, longboards, mini-mals, surf mats, SUPs and alaias
Spring and winter wetsuits, boots, gloves and hoods
goodToKnow: Surf hire is for people who have done a beginner lesson
SUP hire needs proven SUP experience
gaps: Own website (barefootsurf.co.uk) blocked fetching; everything is from a third-party listing, so trading status is unconfirmed; no season, booking terms or accreditations
